title: Moto film edit policy (moto-film-edit-policy-v1)
description: What an edit plan of a film may decide. The phase-11-edit revision stores it as its prompt_content; PHP reads it from the DB and checks every edit plan against it; no model reads it. Every value is one this version carries out: a decision the compiler and the renderer cannot carry out is not accepted here, so it can never be taken and then skipped quietly. What the film cuts — transitions, sound, cards, the output — stays with the film policy of phase-11.

edit_plan.description: The schema an edit plan under this policy is written in.

origins.description: Who may write an edit plan: default is the plan code makes from the approved sources. A plan from a person (manual) or a model (ai) is not taken by this version.

order.description: The segments run in the order of the approved shot plan.

take.description: Each segment uses the clip a person approved for its shot.

trim.description: Each segment keeps the interval its shot keeps in the approved shot plan.

transition.description: Each segment comes in with the transition the approved shot plan names.

omissions.description: A shot is never left out by decision. A shot with no usable clip is missing, which only a preview allows.

audio_tracks.description: The kinds of sound track an edit plan may carry: the sound of the clips only.

colour.description: The colour treatments an edit plan may ask for: none, the picture stays as rendered.

text_tracks.description: The kinds of text track an edit plan may carry: the cards of the pinned script, word for word.

confirmation.description: How an edit plan is confirmed: with_render_request records the confirmation of the plan shown, by its hash, in the request that cuts it.
